name: golden_apr_jul_2026
notes: 250 frames sampled from 25 sessions in 2026-04..07, 10 per session, one per stage2 score decile. Replaced golden_core on 2026-08-07; golden_core labels/manifest/predictions are archived under data/eval/archive_golden_core/ and its 258 preview JPEGs were deleted (regenerable via scripts/eval/sample_eval_set.py from the source archive). golden_core over-weighted 2026-03 (104/250) and included the 2026-01 learning-curve sessions (0/16 keepers) that no longer represent the input distribution. Excludes 2026-05-02, 2026-06-05, 2026-05-09 and 2026-04-10, whose stage2 coverage was too sparse to stratify on. CAVEAT 1: labels come from the Qwen-VL relabel pass plus human review, so every field originates from the model unless a reviewer overrode it -- the 30% blind subset in relabel/blind_split.json is the only AI-independent signal here, and there is no longer a second set with independent human labels. CAVEAT 2: keep is DERIVED, not human: keep = (overall >= 75.0). It carries no information independent of overall, so precision@k / recall@k against this column re-express score correlation rather than measuring selection behaviour -- do not quote them as selection metrics until a human keep pass replaces the column. CAVEAT 3: this set's score scale is not comparable to golden_core's; reports under reports/eval/ predating 2026-08-07 were computed on the old scale.
